props.name: columns
props.description: Table columns after WBS and Task, in order.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Ids of open phases. Every phase starts open by default.

props.name: today
props.description: Date the today column marks. Pass a fixed one for stable screenshots.

props.name: padding
props.description: Empty periods before the first date and after the last.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Mode switch and zoom controls above the chart.

props.name: legend
props.description: Key and hovered-task readout below the chart.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Scroll height of the chart body; rows scroll under a sticky header.

components.name: GanttLegend
components.description: Swatches for each bar color, a milestone and the today column.

examples.title: daily · actuals and forecast columns · no toolbar or legend
examples.setup:
const day = (offset: number) =>
  format(addDays(new Date(), offset), "yyyy-MM-dd")

const SPRINT: GanttTask[] = [
  { id: "1.0", name: "Sprint 14" },
  {
    id: "1.1",
    parent: "1.0",
    name: "Auth refresh",
    progress: 100,
    planStart: day(-6),
    planDays: 3,
    actualStart: day(-6),
    actualEnd: day(-4),
  },
  {
    id: "1.2",
    parent: "1.0",
    name: "Billing page",
    progress: 50,
    planStart: day(-4),
    planDays: 4,
    actualStart: day(-2),
    forecastEnd: day(3),
  },
  {
    id: "1.3",
    parent: "1.0",
    name: "Release",
    milestone: true,
    progress: 0,
    planEnd: day(5),
    dependsOn: ["1.2"],
  },
]
examples.code:
<Gantt
  tasks={SPRINT}
  mode="daily"
  toolbar={false}
  legend={false}
  padding={3}
  columns={["progress", "actual-start", "actual-end", "forecast-end"]}
  aria-label="Sprint schedule"
/>
